explanation: Fires on a high-frequency subword shard (a common prefix, suffix, single letter or digit, code chunk, or ordinary word) at the moment it is being used as one piece of a longer multi-token technical unit: a split surname or eponym (Cast+en, W+ess+eling, D+ijkstra), a code identifier (MAX+_BUFFER, Each+Node, _tr+aced), an inflected or compounded non-English form, or the head-noun slot of a definitional phrase (be a connected graph, the input consists, indexed by). Strength is gated by the surrounding passage, rising sharply in dense technical prose and staying low in plain narrative. It stays near-silent on single-token familiar wholes (Huntington, Darwin, Garcia, Wesley), on names built only from rare shards (Sklodowska's Sk/lod/ows/ka, Vander/meer), and on the same common words in mundane sentences.
